photos.why: Jet Lowe photographed the rear view of the space shuttle Discovery on top of the Shuttle Carrier Aircraft in 2012. A 747 carried the retired orbiters to museums.
photos.k: How does a plane carry a spaceship?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA's Paul Alers photographed the space shuttle Discovery mounted atop a 747 flying over Washington in April 2012. It was on its way to the Smithsonian.
photos.k: Where would you display a space shuttle?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA's Kim Shiflet photographed cranes and wind restraints used to lift the space shuttle Enterprise off its carrier plane in 2012. Enterprise was a test shuttle that never flew in space.
photos.k: Why build a shuttle that does not fly in space?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA's Bill Ingalls photographed a spectator taking a photo of Space Shuttle Endeavour as it moved through Los Angeles in October 2012. The shuttle traveled slowly through the city streets.
photos.k: How do you drive a shuttle through a city?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA's Bill Ingalls photographed a large group of astronauts watching the move of space shuttle Atlantis in 2012. Astronauts from the shuttle era gathered to say goodbye.
photos.k: What would you say to a retired spaceship?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Spitzer Space Telescope photographed a nebula in 2012 that has been an audience favorite. The glowing clouds were colored by infrared light.
photos.k: Why use infrared light for a nebula?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed a dust devil winding across the surface of Mars in 2012. Martian dust devils can be miles high.
photos.k: How does a whirlwind form?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This image from NASA's 2001 Mars Odyssey spacecraft shows Olympus Rupes, a cliff along the edge of Olympus Mons, the largest volcano in the solar system. Lava flows pour down its sides.
photos.k: How big do you think the volcano is?

photos.t: Rock at Rocknest Imaged by Curiosity
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Curiosity rover used its ChemCam laser to study a rock called Rocknest 3 in 2012. The laser zaps rock and reads the light from the vapor.
photos.k: How can a laser tell what a rock is made of?

photos.why: Worshippers throw yellow turmeric powder in the air at a festival at a hilltop temple in Maharashtra, India. The powder turns the whole scene golden.
photos.k: What color would you choose for a festival?

photos.why: The Parthenon crowns the rocky hill of the Acropolis in Athens. It was built about 2,450 years ago to honor the goddess Athena, and the city has grown around it.
photos.k: What do you think Athens looked like when the Parthenon was new?

photos.why: Fishermen pull a boat through the surf, with waves crashing around them. In many places around the world, people still fish from small boats and haul them ashore by hand.
photos.k: How hard do you think this work is?

photos.why: A school of yellow-and-blue fish swims together in the clear water off Fiji. Fish swim in groups to confuse predators, and they all turn as if they were one animal.
photos.k: Why does swimming in a group protect them?

photos.why: This wooden church in Norway was built about 1180 and has dragon heads on its roof. Stave churches are made with upright wooden posts, and this is the best preserved one in the country.
photos.k: Why do you think the roof has dragons?

photos.why: On August 6, 1945, an atomic bomb exploded almost directly above this building in Hiroshima, Japan. Its shell survived and was preserved as a memorial that reminds people of the need for peace.
photos.k: Why would a city keep a ruin like this?

photos.t: The Bastei Bridge in Morning Light
photos.why: Tall sandstone pillars rise above forests in Saxon Switzerland, in Germany, with a stone bridge from 1851 spanning the gaps between them. Painters and hikers have loved the view for centuries.
photos.k: How would you cross between the rocks without a bridge?

photos.t: St. Peter's Basilica at Blue Hour
photos.why: Jebulon photographed the facade of Saint Peter's Basilica in Rome in 2013 at blue hour. The huge church glows in the twilight.
photos.k: How many people can fit in St. Peter's?

photos.why: Vaido Otsar photographed the calm Lake Aalupi in Estonia in 2013. A still surface mirrors the trees and sky.
photos.k: What would you do at a lake like this?

photos.why: Narender9 photographed devotees at the Holi festival in the Krishna temple in Nandgaon and Barsana, India, in 2013. People throw colored powder and water to celebrate spring.
photos.k: What colors would you choose?

photos.why: Richard Bartz photographed a Eurasian oystercatcher, Haematopus ostralegus, in Iceland in 2013. The black-and-white bird has a long orange bill and red eyes.
photos.k: What does the oystercatcher use its bill for?

photos.t: Hong Kong from Tsim Sha Tsui
photos.why: Ralf Roletschek made a panorama of Hong Kong from Tsim Sha Tsui in Kowloon in August 2013. Victoria Harbour is lined with skyscrapers.
photos.k: How many towers can you see?

photos.why: This photograph shows the old windmills in Angla on the island of Saaremaa in Estonia in 2013. Five wooden windmills stand along a ridge.
photos.k: What did people grind in windmills?

photos.why: Ximonic photographed the Geirangerfjord from Ørnesvingen, the Eagle's Bend, in Norway in June 2013. Waterfalls fall into the deep blue fjord between steep green slopes.
photos.k: How was a fjord carved?

photos.t: A Japanese Garden Scene from a Chickee in Keitaku-en
photos.why: Laitche photographed a Japanese garden scene through the roof of a chickee, an open hut, at Keitaku-en in Tokyo in 2013. The picture frames a pond and trees.
photos.k: What do you notice about the garden's shapes?

photos.why: A.Savin photographed the Temple of Poseidon at Cape Sounion in Attica, Greece, in June 2013. The marble temple stands on a cliff above the sea, built in 444 BC.
photos.k: Why would a sea god's temple be on a cliff?

photos.why: Laitche photographed a grey heron at Keitakuen in September 2013. The heron stands still for a long time, waiting for fish.
photos.k: How can a bird be so patient?

photos.why: Martin Falbisoner photographed the U.S. Capitol at dusk from the east side in 2013. The dome glows under evening light.
photos.k: What happens inside the Capitol?

photos.why: Myrabella photographed the red granite Calanques of Piana in Corsica, France, in 2013. The rocks plunge into the sea in odd shapes.
photos.k: What do the rocks look like?

photos.why: Pudelek photographed the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral in Sofia, Bulgaria, in 2013. Its golden domes shine in the sun.
photos.k: Why do cathedrals have golden domes?

photos.t: Lighthouse of the Citadel of Ajaccio
photos.why: Myrabella photographed the lighthouse of the citadel of Ajaccio, in Corsica, in 2013. The old citadel guards the harbor.
photos.k: How does a lighthouse help ships?

photos.t: Gorges du Tarn at Roc des Hourtous
photos.why: Myrabella photographed the Gorges du Tarn at their narrowest part, near Roc des Hourtous, in southern France in 2013. High cliffs enclose the river.
photos.k: What would you feel standing at the bottom?

photos.t: Neuwerk Island in the Wadden Sea
photos.why: Ralf Roletschek photographed the island of Neuwerk in the North Frisian Wadden Sea near Hamburg in 2013. At low tide you can walk across the mud flats.
photos.k: How can you walk to an island?

photos.why: Frank Schulenburg photographed the Point Cabrillo Lighthouse on an early morning in February 2013. The white lighthouse stands on a bluff on California's coast.
photos.k: What would you see from the top?

photos.why: Martin Falbisoner photographed fireworks over the Ponte Vecchio in Florence, Italy, in 2013. The old bridge, built in 1345, glows with the bursts.
photos.k: How would fireworks look on a river?

photos.why: Ralf Roletschek photographed Victoria Harbour from Victoria Peak in Hong Kong in 2013. The harbor spreads below the skyscrapers.
photos.k: What does it feel like to look down on a city?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA's Bill Ingalls photographed NASA Administrator Charles Bolden announcing a tribute to Sally Ride in 2013. Ride, the first American woman in space, had died in 2012.
photos.k: What would you want to remember about her?

photos.why: A dancer in a bright orange costume poses in a classical Indian dance called Bharatanatyam. It comes from southern India and uses hand gestures and facial expressions to tell stories.
photos.k: Can you copy her pose?

photos.why: The great dome of Florence's cathedral glows in the evening, across the roofs of the city. Brunelleschi's dome, finished in 1436, was the largest brick dome in the world.
photos.k: How did they build such a huge dome?

photos.why: In 2014, Hubble photographed the Pillars of Creation again with a new camera, giving a sharper, clearer view. The pillars are columns of gas and dust, and the light from them takes thousands of years to reach us.
photos.k: What looks different from the 1995 picture?

photos.why: During the total lunar eclipse of April 15, 2014, the Moon turned deep red. Sunlight bends through Earth's atmosphere to reach the Moon, and only the red light makes it, so sunset colors fall on the Moon.
photos.k: Why would the Moon turn red?

photos.t: The Moon Setting from the Space Station
photos.cr: JSC
photos.why: Astronaut Reid Wiseman photographed the Moon setting beyond the curve of Earth's atmosphere. From orbit, the atmosphere is a thin blue line.
photos.k: What does it feel like to see the whole Earth's edge?

photos.why: Dmytro Balkhovitin made a panorama of winter dawn on Ai-Petri in Crimea in 2014. Low clouds roll over the mountain.
photos.k: What does it feel like to stand above clouds?

photos.why: Clément Bucco-Lechat photographed the 30th Polo World Cup on Snow in St. Moritz, Switzerland, in 2014. Riders gallop on a frozen lake.
photos.k: How would horses run on snow?

photos.why: Chensiyuan made a panorama at night of Rocinha, the largest favela in Brazil, in 2014. Thousands of lights climb the hillside.
photos.k: How do people build houses on steep hills?

photos.why: Crisco 1492 photographed Sanata Dharma University's Sekar Jepun, a Balinese dance troupe, on 1 November 2014. The dancers wear gold headdresses and bright costumes.
photos.k: What stories do dancers tell?

photos.t: Dome of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre
photos.why: Godot13 photographed the dome of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem from directly overhead. A Christ Pantocrator mosaic fills the center.
photos.k: What do you notice about the pattern?

photos.why: Chensiyuan made a panorama of the Taipei sunrise in December 2014. Taipei 101 rises above the haze.
photos.k: What would you see at sunrise in a big city?

photos.why: Khunkay photographed wild elephants walking on a road in Khao Yai National Park in Thailand in 2014. The park is home to about 300 elephants.
photos.k: What would you do if an elephant crossed your road?

photos.why: Clément Bucco-Lechat photographed Yacine Brahimi in a football match between Algeria and Armenia on 31 May 2014. Brahimi plays for Algeria.
photos.k: What does a football player's face show during a match?

photos.t: Stained Glass, All Saints Catholic Church
photos.why: Nheyob photographed stained glass windows in All Saints Catholic Church in St. Peters, Missouri, in 2014. Colored glass glows when the sun shines through.
photos.k: How is stained glass made?

photos.why: Jacek Halicki photographed the Dzików Castle in Tarnobrzeg, Poland, in 2014. The old castle belonged to the Tarnowski family.
photos.k: What would you like about living in a castle?

photos.why: Diego Delso photographed Dynjandi, a waterfall in the Westfjords of Iceland, on August 14, 2014. It fans out as it falls, like a bridal veil.
photos.k: Why does the waterfall look like a fan?

photos.why: Wilfredor photographed a Sunday at the Sé Cathedral in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2014. People fill the plaza in front.
photos.k: What do people do in a plaza on Sunday?

photos.why: JLPC photographed Bassac Abbey in the Charente region of France in 2014. The abbey was built between the 12th and 18th centuries.
photos.k: How can a building take 600 years to build?

photos.why: This mosaic of Jupiter's moon Europa combines images from the Galileo spacecraft. The icy crust is covered with brown lines and cracks.
photos.k: What might be under Europa's ice?

photos.why: Jacek Halicki photographed the Gothic stone bridge across the Nysa Kłodzka river in Bardo, Poland, in 2014. The 15th-century bridge has statues of saints.
photos.k: How can a bridge last for 600 years?

photos.why: Diego Delso photographed the Great Bath at the Roman Baths in Bath, England, in 2014. The pool is lined with lead and surrounded by columns.
photos.k: Why would Romans build baths in England?

photos.why: Chensiyuan photographed a panorama of Toledo, Spain, from the Parador hotel at sunset in 2014. The old city sits on a hill, ringed by a river.
photos.k: How would you protect a city on a hill?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA photographed Dr. Fran Bagenal, a scientist with the New Horizons mission, in 2014 as the probe approached Pluto. The spacecraft flew past in July 2015.
photos.k: What would you hope to find on Pluto?

photos.t: Hurricane Edouard from the Space Station
photos.cr: JSC
photos.why: ESA astronaut Alexander Gerst photographed Hurricane Edouard from the International Space Station on September 15, 2014. The spiral storm's eye is clear.
photos.k: What does a hurricane look like from above?

photos.t: Iridescent Glory of the Helix Nebula
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This composite picture of the Helix Nebula combines Hubble and Mexican telescope images in 2014. The nebula is the remains of a dying star about 650 light-years away.
photos.k: Why is it called the Eye of God?

photos.why: Uwe Aranas photographed the golden statue of Lord Murugan outside Batu Caves in Selangor, Malaysia, in 2015. The 140-foot statue stands before steep steps up to a temple in a cave.
photos.k: How many steps would you climb?

photos.why: A.Savin photographed Lake Schermützelsee in Buckow, in the Märkische Schweiz region of Germany, in August 2015. Calm water lies in rolling green hills.
photos.k: What would you do at a quiet lake?

photos.t: Chinese New Year Fashion Show, Yogyakarta
photos.why: Crisco 1492 photographed students in a Chinese New Year fashion show on Sudirman Street in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, in 2015. Red and gold costumes filled the street.
photos.k: What colors say celebration to you?

photos.why: 0x010C photographed a kayaker playboating at Saint-Clément-sur-Durance in 2015. Playboaters do tricks in the waves of a river.
photos.k: How do you keep a kayak steady in rapids?

photos.why: Jebulon photographed the west side of the Erechtheion on the Acropolis in Athens in 2015. The porch with statues of women instead of columns is famous.
photos.k: What are the statues holding up?

photos.why: Michael Mainiero photographed a Daher TBM 900 single-engine turboprop in flight in 2015. The photo was taken from another plane.
photos.k: How does a photographer shoot a plane in the air?

photos.why: Edmundo Sáez photographed the Øye stave church in Vang, Oppland, Norway, in 2015. Stave churches are wooden churches of the Middle Ages with carved dragon heads on the roofs.
photos.k: How can wooden churches last 800 years?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: On September 13, 2015, NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory photographed the Moon crossing in front of the Sun. The Moon's jagged edge showed in the solar disk.
photos.k: What's it called when the Moon crosses the Sun?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed dust devils in Ganges Chasma on Mars in 2015. The twisting wind makes dark tracks on the surface.
photos.k: What can dark tracks tell scientists?

photos.why: The bee hummingbird, which lives only in Cuba, is the smallest bird in the world, about 5 centimeters long and weighing around two grams. Its wings beat so fast they blur.
photos.k: How do you think such a tiny bird finds enough food?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This image of a comet shows the rubbery-looking nucleus of Comet 67P, which the European Space Agency's Rosetta spacecraft studied for two years. On September 30, 2016, Rosetta landed softly on the comet to end its mission.
photos.k: What does a comet look like up close compared with the pictures of faraway ones?

photos.t: Royal Albert Hall from a Central Box
photos.why: Colin photographed the inside of the Royal Albert Hall in London in 2016 from a central box. The round hall seats thousands under a giant glass dome.
photos.k: How many seats can you count?

photos.why: SpaceX photographed a Falcon 9 rocket standing upright at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California in 2016. The rocket's first stage can fly back and land for reuse.
photos.k: Why land a rocket instead of throwing it away?

photos.why: Gordon Leggett photographed the Kjeungskjær Lighthouse in Sør-Trøndelag, Norway, in November 2016. The lighthouse stands on a tiny rock out in the sea.
photos.k: Who would live in a lighthouse like this?

photos.why: Mike Peel photographed Gawthorpe Hall in Lancashire, England, in 2016. The Elizabethan hall has a tall stone tower.
photos.k: What would you do in a hall this big?

photos.why: Diego Delso photographed the Vakil Bathhouse in Shiraz, Iran, on 24 September 2016. The 18th-century bath has rows of carved pillars and a high ceiling.
photos.k: Why would a public bath have such beautiful columns?

photos.why: Clément Bardot photographed dunes in the Thar Desert, the Great Indian Desert, in 2016. The wind has sculpted smooth ridges across the sand.
photos.k: How does the wind shape a dune?

photos.by: Museum of Veterinary Anatomy FMVZ USP
photos.why: The Museum of Veterinary Anatomy photographed a mounted skeleton of an ostrich, Struthio camelus, in 2016. The ostrich is the largest living bird and cannot fly but runs fast.
photos.k: How do the legs show how it runs?

photos.why: Faj2323 photographed a bridge near Tatopani in Nepal on 16 March 2016, with Nilgiri South, 6,839 meters high, behind it. The trail crosses the Kali Gandaki gorge.
photos.k: How would you feel crossing a mountain bridge?

photos.why: Jakub Hałun photographed the Phaung Daw U Pagoda in Meiktila, Myanmar, in August 2016. The white and gold pagoda sits beside a lake.
photos.k: What do you see reflected in the water?

photos.why: Christian Ferrer photographed the Pont Vieux and the Saint-Nazaire Cathedral in Béziers, France, in 2016. The old bridge leads toward the hilltop cathedral.
photos.k: How many arches does the bridge have?

photos.why: Julian Colton photographed the Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge at night from Mount Pleasant, South Carolina, in 2016. Its tall diamond-shaped towers are lit blue.
photos.k: How do lights change the look of a bridge?

photos.why: An Air Force photographer photographed a 2nd Air Refueling Squadron tanker refueling B-2 stealth bombers in November 2016. A boom reaches from one plane into the other.
photos.k: How can planes pass fuel in the sky?

photos.t: James Webb Space Telescope Mirror Reveal
photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: NASA photographed the fully assembled mirror of the James Webb Space Telescope in November 2016. The gold-coated beryllium mirror has 18 hexagonal segments.
photos.k: Why is the mirror made of segments?

photos.cr: MSFC
photos.why: NASA's Fred Deaton photographed the winning college team at the 2016 Lunar Rover Challenge. Students designed human-powered rovers to cross a rough course.
photos.k: How would you design a moon buggy?

photos.t: OSIRIS-REx Lifted into Thermal Vacuum Testing
photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: NASA's Marina Behabetz photographed the OSIRIS-REx spacecraft being lifted into thermal vacuum testing in 2016. Spacecraft are tested in chambers that mimic space.
photos.k: Why test spacecraft in a chamber?

photos.t: Deposits along the Northern Wall of Melas Chasma
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This image from NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter shows layered deposits along the northern wall of Melas Chasma, a deep canyon in Valles Marineris on Mars. Layers hint at water.
photos.k: What can layers in a canyon tell you?

photos.cr: AFRC
photos.why: On August 21, 2017, the Moon covered the Sun across the United States. Just as totality ends, a bright spot of sunlight peeks through valleys on the Moon's edge, called the diamond ring effect. NASA photographer Carla Thomas captured it.
photos.k: Why are special glasses needed to look at a partial eclipse?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory watches the Sun all day and night in many colors of ultraviolet light. Here it shows a big solar flare, a sudden burst of energy that can affect satellites and power grids.
photos.k: How is the Sun different from what we see in the sky?

photos.why: Dolphinphoto5d photographed the asbads, ancient windmills, in Sistan, Iran, in 2017. The vertical mills have caught the strong 120-day wind for a thousand years.
photos.k: How does a windmill use the wind?

photos.why: DeFacto photographed the gatehouse of Carisbrooke Castle on the Isle of Wight in 2017. The castle dates back to Norman times, and King Charles I was held prisoner there.
photos.k: How would you defend a castle gate?

photos.t: Circumpolar Star Trails at La Hague Lighthouse
photos.why: Antoine Lamielle photographed circumpolar star trails over La Hague lighthouse in France in April 2017. Stars appear to circle the North Star as Earth turns.
photos.k: Why do the stars seem to go around?

photos.t: Aurora Australis over the Tasman Sea
photos.why: Jamen Percy photographed the aurora australis over the Tasman Sea from South West National Park in Tasmania in 2017. The southern lights glow in green and pink.
photos.k: What makes the aurora glow?

photos.why: Ezarate photographed the Malecón, Havana's seawall and avenue, in 2017. Old cars and buildings line the waterfront.
photos.k: Why do people stroll along a seawall?

photos.t: A Foggy Winter Morning in Bangladesh
photos.why: Abdul Momin photographed a foggy winter morning in Bangladesh in 2017. Mist softens the trees and fields.
photos.k: What does fog sound like?

photos.t: Golden Gate Bridge from Battery East
photos.why: Frank Schulenburg photographed the Golden Gate Bridge from Battery East in San Francisco in 2017. Fog sometimes wraps its towers.
photos.k: Why is San Francisco so foggy?

photos.t: Boys Playing Street Football in Egypt
photos.why: Mohamed Hozyen Ahmed photographed children playing street football in Egypt in 2017. Streets are the soccer fields where many champions learn.
photos.k: Where do you play games with friends?

photos.why: Rhododendrites photographed Dyker Lights, the famous Christmas displays in the Dyker Heights neighborhood of Brooklyn, in 2017. Whole houses are wrapped in lights and inflatable figures.
photos.k: How many lights would you hang?

photos.why: Ermell photographed the Catholic St. Veit pilgrimage church on a hill in Ansbach, Germany. The baroque church stands on a pilgrim route.
photos.k: Why would a pilgrim walk to a church?

photos.why: Charles J. Sharp photographed a male African emerald cuckoo, Chrysococcyx cupreus, in 2017. Its feathers shine a metallic green.
photos.k: Why would a bird have shiny green feathers?

photos.why: Ara9979 photographed the Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque in Isfahan, Iran, in 2017. The mosque's dome is covered in cream and blue tiles, and the inside has a peacock pattern that changes with the light.
photos.k: How do tiles make patterns?

photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: This photograph from an exhibit at the Annenberg Space for Photography shows Cuban jazz musician Bobby Carcassés playing a horn in Havana in 2017. Carcassés is known as a singer, trumpeter and percussionist.
photos.k: What music would you play on a horn?

photos.cr: ARC
photos.why: NASA's Dominic Hart photographed the totality of the solar eclipse on August 21, 2017, in Salem, Oregon. The Sun's corona glows around the black disk of the Moon.
photos.k: What does a total eclipse feel like?

photos.cr: ARC
photos.why: J-P Wiens photographed a researcher taking a break during the 2017 solar eclipse at the Ames Research Center in California. He wears special glasses to look at the Sun.
photos.k: Why do you need special glasses?

photos.t: Pillars of Creation in High Definition
photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: Hubble revisited the Pillars of Creation in the Eagle Nebula with a sharper camera in 2015. The columns of gas and dust, about 5 light-years tall, are nurseries for new stars.
photos.k: What are the pillars made of?

photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: Hubble combined years of images to assemble its farthest-ever view of the universe in 2017. The photograph shows about 15,000 galaxies in one patch of sky.
photos.k: How many galaxies does one small patch hold?

photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: NASA's Kim Shiflett photographed a presentation in 2017 of the lessons learned from the Apollo 1 fire of 1967. Mike Ciannilli led the program remembering the three astronauts who died.
photos.k: Why does NASA keep remembering its accidents?

photos.t: A Dust Devil on Hilly Terrain
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: The Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed a dust devil spinning across hilly terrain on Mars in 2017. The dust devil's shadow stretches long across the surface.
photos.k: How tall can a dust devil on Mars be?

photos.t: Hurricane Florence from the Space Station
photos.why: Astronauts aboard the International Space Station photographed Hurricane Florence in September 2018 as it grew over the Atlantic. The huge storm has an open eye in the middle, with towering clouds spiraling around.
photos.k: How big do you think a hurricane is compared with a country?

photos.why: Jeevan Jose photographed Attacus taprobanis, a giant silk moth, in Kadavoor, Kerala, in July 2018. The moth's wings have transparent windows and tip patterns that look like snake heads.
photos.k: Why would wings look like snakes?

photos.why: Frank Schulenburg photographed the historic windmill near Nebel on the island of Amrum, Germany, in 2018. The white mill is a local landmark.
photos.k: What do you see on the horizon?

photos.t: African Bush Elephant with a Six-Week-Old Calf
photos.why: Charles J. Sharp photographed a female African bush elephant with her six-week-old calf in 2018. The baby stays close to its mother's legs.
photos.k: How does a baby elephant learn to use its trunk?

photos.why: Rhododendrites photographed a man working on a glass project at Brooklyn Glass in New York in 2018. Hot glass glows orange when it comes from the furnace.
photos.k: How do glassblowers shape melted glass?

photos.why: George Chernilevsky photographed the monument to Bohdan Khmelnytsky in Kyiv in 2018. The bronze statue of the Cossack leader on a rearing horse stands on a square.
photos.k: Why do cities put statues on squares?

photos.why: Moahim photographed Christiansborg Palace in Copenhagen from the Marble Bridge in 2018. The tall tower is the seat of the Danish Parliament.
photos.k: What does the tower remind you of?

photos.why: H. Zell photographed a sun parakeet, Aratinga solstitialis, at Loro Parque on Tenerife in 2018. The parakeet's feathers are bright yellow and orange.
photos.k: How many colors can you count?

photos.why: Moahim photographed Nyhavn, the colorful harbor in Copenhagen, at sunset in 2018. The row of bright 17th-century houses lines the canal.
photos.k: Which house color do you like?

photos.why: Michal Klajban photographed the Parliament Building in Victoria, British Columbia, in 2018. The stone building is lit with thousands of lights at night.
photos.k: What does a legislature do?

photos.why: Charles J. Sharp photographed a male Amber Mountain rock thrush, Monticola sharpei erythronotus, in Madagascar in 2018. The bird is blue with an orange belly.
photos.k: Why do male birds have bright colors?

photos.why: Rbrechko photographed the Kamianets-Podilskyi Castle in Ukraine in 2018. The fortress sits on a rock in a bend of the river Smotrych.
photos.k: Why build a castle in a river's bend?

photos.why: Isiwal photographed the 2018 FIM Ice Speedway Gladiators World Championship Grand Prix in Poland. Riders on studded tires lean far over on the ice.
photos.k: How do spikes help on ice?

photos.why: Uoaei1 photographed the Martyrs' Window in the south aisle of Freiburg Minster in Germany in 2018. The stained glass tells stories of saints in bright colors.
photos.k: How do you tell a story in glass?

photos.why: Moahim photographed sunrise in Jasmund National Park on the island of Rügen in Germany in 2019. The park has white chalk cliffs and beech forest.
photos.k: How do chalk cliffs form?

photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: Carol M. Highsmith photographed a Grand Canyon Railway excursion train, which runs from Williams, Arizona, in 2018. The train carries visitors to the canyon rim.
photos.k: Would you like to ride to the Grand Canyon by train?

photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: Carol M. Highsmith photographed the Grand Canyon Depot, one of the last log train stations in America, in 2018. The depot was built in 1909 and sits at the canyon's South Rim.
photos.k: Why build a station out of logs?

photos.t: Graveyard at Grand Canyon National Park
photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: Carol M. Highsmith photographed a graveyard at Grand Canyon National Park in northern Arizona in 2018. It holds graves of early settlers and park workers.
photos.k: What do old gravestones tell you?

photos.t: A Necessary Traffic Sign at Grand Canyon National Park
photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: Carol M. Highsmith photographed a traffic sign at Grand Canyon National Park in 2018. Elk and other wildlife often cross the roads.
photos.k: Why would a sign warn about animals?

photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: NASA's Kim Shiflett photographed the antennas of the Parker Solar Probe being deployed in 2018. The probe flew closer to the Sun than any spacecraft before it.
photos.k: How can a spacecraft survive so near the Sun?

photos.t: SpaceX Crew Dragon in an Anechoic Chamber
photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: SpaceX's Crew Dragon spacecraft sits in an anechoic chamber in 2018, a room that absorbs radio waves. Engineers test the spacecraft's communications.
photos.k: Why would a room need to absorb waves?

photos.why: Tall green bamboo stalks fill a path in the Arashiyama forest, near Kyoto in Japan. Some bamboo can grow up to a meter in a single day.
photos.k: What sound do you think the stalks make in the wind?

photos.why: Michal Klajban photographed the Christchurch Art Gallery in New Zealand in 2019. The glass and metal building was damaged by the 2011 earthquake and later reopened.
photos.k: How can a building survive an earthquake?

photos.why: JJ Harrison photographed an aragonite crystal from Los Molinillos, Cuenca, Spain, in 2019. The crystal is about four centimeters wide and shows fine hexagonal shapes.
photos.k: What does a crystal's shape tell you?

photos.why: Azim Khan Ronnie photographed the 201 Dome Mosque in Tangail District, Bangladesh, from above in 2019. Its many small domes make a repeating pattern.
photos.k: How many domes can you see?

photos.by: This photo was taken by Anton Zelenov
photos.why: This photograph shows the abandoned rusty cargo ship Edro III near Pegeia, Cyprus, in 2019. The ship ran aground in 2011 and has become a popular spot for visitors.
photos.k: What happens to a ship after a wreck?

photos.t: Neon Street Signs at Blue Hour, Shinjuku
photos.why: Basile Morin photographed buildings with colorful neon street signs at blue hour in Shinjuku, Tokyo, in 2019. The glow of the signs fills the twilight.
photos.k: What do neon signs do at night?

photos.why: A physics PhD student, Nutsinee Kijbunchoo, photographed with confusion at the LIGO observatory in 2019. LIGO detects gravitational waves, tiny ripples in space.
photos.k: How can you measure a ripple in space?

photos.t: Eastern Screech Owl Rehabilitated After Eye Injury
photos.why: Rhododendrites photographed a rehabilitated eastern screech owl in 2019 after an eye injury. Wildlife centers care for injured birds.
photos.k: What does an owl need to survive?

photos.t: Asahi Breweries Headquarters and the Asahi Flame
photos.why: Basile Morin photographed the Asahi Breweries headquarters in Tokyo with the Asahi Flame sculpture in 2019. The gold sculpture is supposed to look like a flame, but some say it looks like something else.
photos.k: What does the gold sculpture look like to you?

photos.why: Basile Morin photographed the red Kabukichō gate and colorful neon signs at night in Shinjuku, Tokyo, in 2019. Kabukichō is a busy entertainment district.
photos.k: How does a gate set a place apart?

photos.cr: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
photos.why: This portrait of actress Selma Blair, photographed for an exhibit at the Annenberg Space for Photography in 2019, shows her in a dress and with a cane. She has spoken about living with multiple sclerosis.
photos.k: How can a portrait show strength?

photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: In 2019 NASA renamed a facility in honor of Katherine Johnson, a hidden figure of the space program. Johnson calculated trajectories for early American space flights.
photos.k: What would you name for someone you admire?

photos.cr: MSFC
photos.why: NASA's Fred Deaton photographed the 2019 Lunar Rover Challenge competition. Student teams built human-powered vehicles to drive over a field of moon-like obstacles.
photos.k: What would you design for a lunar rover?

photos.why: Ivar Leidus photographed coarse Himalayan salt crystals from Pakistan in 2020. The pink grains are up to five millimeters across.
photos.k: Why is Himalayan salt pink?

photos.t: Everything Is Going to Be Alright
photos.why: Michal Klajban photographed the neon artwork Everything Is Going to Be Alright at the Christchurch Art Gallery in 2020. The glowing words became a symbol of hope during the pandemic.
photos.k: What message would you put in neon?

photos.t: View from Okrążek Rock to Tyniec Abbey
photos.why: Jakub Hałun photographed the view from Okrążek Rock to the Benedictine Abbey of Tyniec, in Poland, in May 2020. The old abbey stands on a limestone cliff above the Vistula river.
photos.k: Why would monks pick a high cliff?

photos.why: Azim Khan Ronnie photographed the Buddha Dhatu Jadi, a large Buddhist temple in Bangladesh, with a drone in 2020. The golden stupa stands on a hill.
photos.k: What do you see from above?

photos.t: ECOSTRESS Images California Wildfires from Space
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's ECOSTRESS instrument on the International Space Station photographed the California wildfires in 2020. Thermal images show the hottest areas in bright colors.
photos.k: How can heat be seen from space?

photos.t: A Golden Eagle in the Alps
photos.why: A golden eagle soars in front of the snowy Alps. Golden eagles are among the largest birds of prey, with a wingspan of up to about two meters, and they can spot small animals from far away.
photos.k: How far do you think an eagle can see?

photos.t: A Marmot in the Swiss Alps
photos.why: A wild alpine marmot sits in the grass in the mountains, watching. Marmots whistle to warn each other of danger and sleep through the winter in deep burrows.
photos.k: What would you whistle to warn a friend?

photos.why: Agnes Monkelbaan photographed a flower of a Camellia × williamsii 'Roger Hall' on 20 April 2021. Camellias bloom in early spring with layered pink petals.
photos.k: How many petals can you count?

photos.why: Md. Ahsanul Haque Nayem photographed the Somapura Mahavihara in Naogaon, Bangladesh, from the air in 2021. The ruins of the Buddhist monastery from the 8th century form a huge square.
photos.k: Why would a monastery be built in a square?

photos.why: Giles Laurent photographed a wild golden eagle flying at Pfyn-Finges in Switzerland in 2021. Golden eagles have a wingspan of over two meters.
photos.k: How does an eagle glide without flapping?

photos.why: Ivar Leidus photographed crystallized acanthite from the Imiter mine in Morocco in 2021. Acanthite is a silver ore and forms dark metallic crystals.
photos.k: Why would silver form crystals?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: On December 25, 2021, the James Webb Space Telescope launched from French Guiana on an Ariane 5 rocket. NASA's Bill Ingalls photographed the ESA Director-General at the launch.
photos.k: Why did the telescope need to travel so far?

photos.t: Bottom of the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: An Ingenuity team member inspects the bottom of NASA's Mars helicopter in 2021 before it flew on Mars. Ingenuity made the first powered flight on another planet.
photos.k: How does a helicopter fly in thin air?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover took a selfie with the Ingenuity helicopter in April 2021 using a camera at the end of its arm. The helicopter stands about 4 meters away.
photos.k: How can a rover take a selfie?

photos.why: This small bird has bright blue feathers and a long tail with a crest on its head. It lives in the forests of central Africa. Giles Laurent photographed it in Uganda's Kibale National Park.
photos.k: How do you think a long tail helps a bird?

photos.why: An alpha male chimpanzee sits quietly in the forest, looking at the camera. Chimpanzees are one of our closest living relatives and share about 98 percent of our DNA.
photos.k: What do you think he is thinking?

photos.t: The Pillars of Creation, Seen by Webb
photos.why: In 2022 the James Webb Space Telescope looked at the Pillars of Creation in near-infrared light, which can see through dust. The red dots at the tips are baby stars just beginning to form.
photos.k: How is this different from the Hubble pictures of the same pillars?

photos.why: On July 12, 2022, NASA shared Webb's first full-color images. The Cosmic Cliffs are the edge of a huge cloud of gas in the Carina Nebula where stars are forming. The mountains and valleys seem to glow, though the tallest peaks are about seven light-years high.
photos.k: How can gas clouds look like mountains?

photos.cr: STScI
photos.why: A dying star at the center has puffed off layers of gas. Webb photographed it in two different kinds of infrared light, on the left with its near-infrared camera and on the right with its mid-infrared one, and the images show different details.
photos.k: Which picture shows more of the central stars?

photos.why: Giles Laurent photographed a red-chested cuckoo in Kibale Forest National Park, Uganda, in 2022. Its song is a three-note call, whose sound means rain is coming in Africa.
photos.k: What does a bird call tell you?

photos.why: Charles J. Sharp photographed a chestnut-headed bee-eater, Merops leschenaulti, at Yala National Park in Sri Lanka in 2022. Bee-eaters catch insects in flight.
photos.k: How does a bird catch a bee?

photos.why: Agnes Monkelbaan photographed a swelling flower bud of wild garlic, Allium ursinum, on 18 April 2022. The leaves smell strongly of garlic.
photos.k: Why might a plant smell so strongly?

photos.why: Christian Ferrer photographed the Romanian tall ship Mircea moored at the Quai d'Alger in Sète, France, in 2022. The three-masted training ship has white sails.
photos.k: What would it be like to sail on a tall ship?

photos.why: Dietmar Rabich photographed San Francisco in 2022. The hilly city is crossed by famous streets and a tall pyramid-shaped tower.
photos.k: What makes San Francisco special?

photos.t: A Smiling Member of the Ramnami Samaj
photos.why: Arpan Basu photographed a smiling member of the Ramnami Samaj in 2022. The Ramnami people of India are known for tattooing the name Ram all over their bodies.
photos.k: Why would someone tattoo a word on their body?

photos.t: Artemis I SLS at Launch Complex 39B
photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: NASA's Jason Parrish photographed a close-up of the Space Launch System rocket for Artemis I standing on Launch Complex 39B in 2022. The rocket sent the Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
photos.k: How tall is a moon rocket?

photos.cr: LRC
photos.why: NASA's Double Asteroid Redirection Test team at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory watched as the spacecraft hit an asteroid in September 2022. It was the first test of changing an asteroid's path.
photos.k: Why would we want to nudge an asteroid?

photos.t: Juno Skims the Cloud Tops of Jupiter
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: On April 9, 2022, NASA's Juno spacecraft skimmed the cloud tops of Jupiter and took a picture of swirling storms. Citizen scientists processed the colors.
photos.k: What do you think the swirls are?

photos.t: How InSight Studies Mars' Inner Layers
photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's InSight Mars lander used a seismometer to listen for marsquakes and learn about the layers inside Mars. This illustration shows how the waves travel.
photos.k: How can listening to quakes show what's inside a planet?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This illustration shows NASA's DART spacecraft about to hit Dimorphos, a small moonlet of the asteroid Didymos, in 2022. The impact changed its orbit by 32 minutes.
photos.k: What would it be like to watch it happen?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This image from NASA's Mars Odyssey spacecraft shows part of the northeast portion of Jezero Crater on Mars, where the Perseverance rover landed in 2021. The crater once held a lake.
photos.k: What clues would you look for to find a lake?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: The James Webb Space Telescope photographed rings of dust around a double star system called Wolf-Rayet 140 in 2022. Each ring forms when two stars pass close together.
photos.k: How do two stars make rings?

photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: This artist's illustration shows NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft flying over land. The plane is designed to make a soft thump instead of a sonic boom.
photos.k: How can a plane fly faster than sound quietly?

photos.why: This nudibranch, or sea slug, wears bright blue and purple colors to warn predators that it tastes bad. Many sea slugs get chemicals from the sponges they eat and use them as defense.
photos.k: Why would a snail without a shell have such bright colors?

photos.why: The Roman Bridge crosses the Guadalquivir River in Córdoba, with the city's great cathedral behind it. The cathedral began as a mosque more than a thousand years ago, and still has hundreds of red-and-white arches inside.
photos.k: What would you cross to reach this city?

photos.why: The Andromeda Galaxy can be seen with the naked eye on a dark night, but a long exposure shows its swirling arms. Amateurs now make photographs of galaxies that would have needed observatories in the past.
photos.k: How many stars do you think Andromeda has?

photos.t: The Church of St. John at Kaneo
photos.why: A small stone church stands on a cliff above Lake Ohrid, in North Macedonia. It was built in the 1200s, and the water below is among the deepest and oldest lakes in Europe.
photos.k: How do you think people got to the church?

photos.why: A round nest hangs among the leaves of a tree. Stingless bees live in many warm countries, making honey and wax but, as their name says, not stinging.
photos.k: How do you think they build a ball hanging from a branch?

photos.why: Comet C/2022 E3 (ZTF) glows green because its gas contains carbon molecules that shine in sunlight. It passed close to Earth in early 2023, for the first time in about 50,000 years.
photos.k: What do you think will happen to the comet next?

photos.why: Ivar Leidus photographed blue azurite crystals covering matrix from the New Nevada Lode in La Sal, Utah. Azurite is a copper mineral with a deep blue color.
photos.k: Why is azurite so blue?

photos.why: Tournasol7 photographed the Mailáth Castle in Donji Miholjac, Croatia, in 2023. The pale castle stands in a park.
photos.k: What would you do in a castle's garden?

photos.why: JackyM59 photographed the southeast side of the Château de Brissac in Maine-et-Loire, France, in 2023. It is the tallest castle in France, with seven stories.
photos.k: How many stories can you count?

photos.t: OpComm Delivery for Orion Artemis II
photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: NASA's Glenn Benson photographed a close-up of one of the parts of Orion's optical communications system, delivered for Artemis II in 2023. The system will beam data and video from the Moon by laser.
photos.k: How can lasers send video from the Moon?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: This image from NASA's Mars Odyssey spacecraft shows the Jezero Crater delta on Mars. The delta, with fan-shaped deposits, formed where an ancient river entered a lake.
photos.k: What do deltas look like on Earth?

photos.why: A Polynesian flying fox, a kind of fruit bat, spreads its wings against a blue sky. With wings that can span almost a meter, it flies at night to eat fruit and spreads seeds.
photos.k: How is a fruit bat different from a bird?

photos.why: Tisha Mukherjee photographed a Baillon's crake, Zapornia pusilla, in Baruipur, India, in February 2024. These small marsh birds are shy and hide in reeds.
photos.k: How would you find a bird that hides?

photos.why: Tisha Mukherjee photographed a banded bay cuckoo in the Ajodhya Hills in July 2024. It has a patterned back and a loud call.
photos.k: What is a cuckoo's call like?

photos.why: Václav Jiroušek photographed the baroque library hall in the Clementinum in Prague in 2024. Painted ceilings and golden shelves are filled with old books.
photos.k: What book would you choose to read there?

photos.by: This Photo was taken by Timothy A. Gonsalves.  Feel free to use my photos, but p
photos.why: This photograph shows Mallalli Falls in Hassan, Karnataka, India, with a coral tree in monsoon in June 2024. The monsoon rains swell the waterfall.
photos.k: What does a monsoon do to rivers?

photos.why: Giles Laurent photographed a toco toucan in Encontro das Águas State Park in Brazil in 2024. The toucan's huge orange bill is light and hollow.
photos.k: Why would a bird have such a big bill?

photos.why: Giles Laurent photographed a male green kingfisher in Encontro das Águas State Park in Brazil in 2024. Kingfishers dive for fish.
photos.k: How does a kingfisher catch fish?

photos.u: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI~large.jpg
photos.th: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI~medium.jpg
photos.hi: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI/Gateway - Orion - Artemis VI~orig.jpg
photos.cr: JSC
photos.why: This illustration from 2024 shows the Orion spacecraft delivering the crew to the Gateway space station through an airlock on the Artemis VI mission. Gateway is planned to orbit the Moon.
photos.k: What would it be like to live in a space station near the Moon?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Perseverance rover took a selfie with a rock called Cheyava Falls in 2024. The rock has leopard-like spots that might be signs of ancient microbial life.
photos.k: What would you ask the rock?

photos.why: Tisha Mukherjee photographed a Bengal bushlark in Baruipur, India, in October 2025. The streaky brown bird sings in flight.
photos.k: How do you find a bird that blends in with the ground?

photos.why: Kallerna photographed Belcastel, a medieval village in Aveyron, France, in 2025. It is listed as one of the most beautiful villages in France, with a castle and a stone bridge.
photos.k: How would you describe a beautiful village?

photos.why: Tisha Mukherjee photographed an Asian emerald dove in Kuldiha Wildlife Sanctuary in March 2025. The dove has shiny green wings.
photos.k: How do green wings help a bird hide in the forest?

photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: In this video frame, scientist Jason Dworkin holds up a vial with a sample of the asteroid Bennu. OSIRIS-REx brought the sample back to Earth in 2023.
photos.k: What would scientists learn from an asteroid sample?

photos.t: Aurora Borealis at Kennedy Space Center
photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: NASA's Ben Smegelsky photographed a faint glow of an aurora seen from Kennedy Space Center in Florida in 2025. Strong solar storms can push auroras far south.
photos.k: Why is an aurora in Florida unusual?

photos.t: NASA Lander to Test Vacuum Cleaner on the Moon
photos.cr: MSFC
photos.why: A technician works on a lander built by Firefly Aerospace that will test a vacuum-style tool to collect moon samples. It is a tiny robot built to pick up the soil.
photos.k: How would you collect dust on the Moon?

photos.t: Asteroid Bennu Researchers at NASA Goddard
photos.cr: GSFC
photos.why: Vivian Renkey photographed the team of researchers who study samples of the asteroid Bennu at NASA Goddard in 2025. The researchers in white suits grin in the lab.
photos.k: Why would scientists wear suits in a clean room?

photos.cr: JPL
photos.why: NASA's Perseverance rover took a selfie in 2025 with a dust devil on the horizon. The twisting dust column crept into the picture.
photos.k: How would a photobomb on Mars happen?

photos.cr: JSC
photos.why: Earth, a bright crescent of blue, sets behind the horizon of the Moon, photographed from NASA's Orion spacecraft in 2026. Like the Earthrise pictures of Apollo, it shows how our planet looks from the Moon.
photos.k: Which one do you think looks more beautiful, an earthrise or an earthset?

photos.u: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield~large.jpg
photos.th: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield~medium.jpg
photos.hi: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield/Artemis IV Orion Heat Shield~orig.jpg
photos.cr: KSC
photos.why: More than 180 blocks of a material called Avcoat are bonded to the heat shield of the Orion spacecraft for Artemis IV in 2026. The shield protects astronauts as the capsule returns through Earth's atmosphere.
photos.k: Why does a spacecraft get hot on reentry?

photos.t: Beyond the Deep Field: Hubble's Legacy
photos.cr: HQ
photos.why: NASA photographed an event in 2026 about Hubble's legacy and the future of cosmic exploration. Hubble has been in orbit for over 35 years.
photos.k: What has Hubble taught us?

collections.name: Photos for Kids
collections.blurb: Animals, space, firsts and funny faces, with a challenge to find something in each.
collections.intro: These are the photographs kids tend to love: animals up close, rockets and rovers, the very first pictures ever taken, and a few surprises. Each one has a "look closer" challenge.

collections.name: The First Photographs
collections.blurb: Silver plates, paper negatives and the people who were brave enough to sit still.
collections.intro: These pictures were made in the first twenty-five years of photography, between 1826 and 1850, when making a single picture could take hours of sunshine and a lot of chemistry.

collections.name: The American Civil War
collections.blurb: Brady, Gardner, O'Sullivan and Barnard carried cameras to the battlefields.
collections.intro: The Civil War was the first big American war to be photographed. Cameras were too slow to catch the fighting, so photographers recorded camps, ruins and the places where battles had been fought.

collections.name: Photographing the American West
collections.blurb: Watkins, Jackson, O'Sullivan and Adams showed Americans their own wild lands.
collections.intro: Before there were highways and airplanes, photographers hauled huge cameras by mule to Yosemite, Yellowstone and the deserts. Their pictures helped people see why wild places were worth protecting.

collections.name: The Great Depression
collections.blurb: The government sent photographers across America to record hard times.
collections.intro: In the 1930s, a Farm Security Administration photography unit hired Dorothea Lange, Walker Evans and others to record what the Depression and the Dust Bowl did to American families.

collections.name: Color Before Color Film
collections.blurb: Autochromes, photochroms and three-filter color from a century ago.
collections.intro: Color photographs are older than you think. The Lumière brothers' Autochrome plates, Prokudin-Gorsky's three-color process and the Swiss photochrom all gave people glimpses of the world in color long before color film.

collections.name: Women Behind the Camera
collections.blurb: Cameron, Käsebier, Lange, Abbott and more.
collections.intro: Women were making great photographs from the start. Julia Margaret Cameron began at 48, Gertrude Käsebier ran New York's busiest portrait studio, and Dorothea Lange gave the Depression a face.

collections.name: Lewis Hine and the Children of Work
collections.blurb: Photographs that helped change the law.
collections.intro: Between 1908 and 1920 Lewis Hine photographed children working in mills, mines and streets for the National Child Labor Committee. His pictures helped end child labor in the United States.

collections.name: Photography as Art
collections.blurb: Stieglitz, Steichen, Käsebier, White and Coburn argued that photographs could be art.
collections.intro: Around 1900, Alfred Stieglitz and a circle of friends began to insist that photographs could be as beautiful as paintings. They made soft, dreamy pictures, then sharp, modern ones.

collections.name: Paris Through the Lens
collections.blurb: Marville, Atget, Nadar and the streets of the City of Light.
collections.intro: Paris has been photographed since the very beginning. Marville recorded streets before they were torn down, Atget photographed it at dawn, and Nadar took portraits and the first aerial pictures.

collections.name: Egypt and the Nile
collections.blurb: Sphinxes, temples and Nile travelers' cameras.
collections.intro: Photographers have been going to Egypt since the 1840s. Du Camp, Frith and Greene hauled cameras up the Nile to photograph temples that were half buried in sand.

collections.name: Asia Through the Lens
collections.blurb: India, China, Burma and Japan in the 1800s.
collections.intro: Photographers like Felice Beato, Samuel Bourne, John Thomson and Raja Deen Dayal made some of the first photographs of India, China and Southeast Asia.

collections.name: Out of This World
collections.blurb: From the Moon to the edge of the universe.
collections.intro: Cameras went to space almost as soon as people did. These photographs, from the first moonwalk to the Webb Space Telescope, show our planet and the cosmos as no one had seen them before.

collections.name: Animals and Nature
collections.blurb: Birds, bugs, crystals and creatures, up close.
collections.intro: Modern cameras can freeze a hummingbird or show the eye of a fly. These photographs from Wikimedia Commons show wild things in sharp detail.

collections.name: Faces of History
collections.blurb: Lincoln, Douglass, Darwin, Tubman, Edison, Tolstoy and others.
collections.intro: Photographs let us look into the eyes of people who lived long ago. These portraits show writers, inventors, leaders and rebels as they really looked.

collections.name: Faces of Freedom
collections.blurb: Douglass, Truth, Tubman, Parks, Robinson and the March on Washington.
collections.intro: People who fought for freedom and equality, from a man who escaped slavery to the crowds who marched on Washington.

collections.name: City Lights and Skyscrapers
collections.blurb: From horse-drawn streets to the Empire State Building.
collections.intro: As cities grew taller and busier, photographers followed. Stieglitz, Strand, Abbott and Hine showed how new skyscrapers and crowds changed the way people lived.

collections.name: Wars and Their Aftermath
collections.blurb: From the Crimean War to D-Day.
collections.intro: Photographers have followed armies since 1855. These pictures show soldiers, ruins and the moments when wars ended, and some are hard to look at.

collections.name: To the Moon
collections.blurb: The Moon, from Apollo to Orion.
collections.intro: People have looked at the Moon for as long as there have been people. These photographs show the Moon up close, from the first Apollo pictures to the newest spacecraft.
